items.name: Deccan Cube Open - August 2017

venue.name: SRR Heights
venue.address: 87, KVR Paradise Colony Rd, Bowrampet, Hyderabad, Telangana 500090

items.information: Partipants needs to pre-register for the event in WCA as they will not be allowed to do any spot registrations on 13th August 2017 to participate. Participation registration for the event closes on 11th August 2017 at 9:00pm IST. Payment also should be made before 11th August 2017 9:00pm IST. Please note once you register in WCA site for the DC open - August 2017, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events. Additional information wll be provided in the tabs.
